fixtures.prompt: Implement clamp(n:number,min:number,max:number):number assuming min<=max. Use Math.min and Math.max, no validation. Return JSON {code} containing only this exported one-line function, with explicit types.

fixtures.prompt: Fix function last(xs: number[]): number | undefined { return xs[xs.length]; } so last([4,7])===7 and last([])===undefined. Return JSON {code} with the exported one-line function, retaining signature and using an indexed return expression.

expected.code: export function last(xs: number[]): number | undefined { return xs[xs.length - 1]; }

fixtures.prompt: Refactor export function twice(n: number): number { const a = n + n; return a; } by inlining a, changing nothing else. Return JSON {code}.

expected.code: export function twice(n: number): number { return n + n; }
